components.name: Primary action
components.description: Accent action for the current reading mode; actual behavior comes from the production page.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.5rem;min-height:48px;padding:.9rem 1.4rem;background:var(--accent,#2c5e7e);color:var(--bg,#f5f3ed);font:500 .88rem/1.65 var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans',Arial,sans-serif);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--duration,220ms),transform var(--duration,220ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-button-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2c5e7e);outline-offset:5px}.ds-icon{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;transition:transform var(--duration,220ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-button-primary:hover .ds-icon{transform:translateX(2px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary,.ds-icon{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 24px;gap:1.6rem;padding-block:1.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#d3d8d4);color:var(--text,#202a2b);font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans',Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-date{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted,#5e696c)}.ds-date span{display:block;color:var(--accent,#2c5e7e);font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace);margin-bottom:.4rem}.ds-meta{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted,#5e696c);margin-bottom:.7rem}.ds-note h2{margin:0;font:400 1.75rem/1.12 var(--font-display,'Newsreader',Georgia,serif);letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-note h2 a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-note p{margin:.55rem 0 0;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#5e696c)}.ds-row-arrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;align-self:center;width:44px;height:44px;margin-left:-10px;color:inherit}.ds-row-arrow:hover .ds-icon{transform:translateX(2px)}.ds-note a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2c5e7e);outline-offset:5px}.ds-icon{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;transition:transform var(--duration,220ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-note{grid-template-columns:1fr 24px;gap:.75rem}.ds-date{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:1rem}.ds-date span{margin:0}.ds-note h2{font-size:1.85rem}.ds-note p{font-size:.85rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-icon{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
AeroAspirant pairs the patient clarity of a scientific notebook with the scale of an aerospace image archive. Warm off-white reading surfaces, fine rules, and editorial serif headings make technical work approachable. Midnight exploration surfaces give authentic imagery room to lead; restrained blueprint blue marks interaction and amber identifies pending work.

The system is an open record of engineering in progress. Source captions, dates, limitations, and selectable technical content belong within the visual hierarchy. Conventional navigation and progressive enhancement keep the fieldbook usable alongside its immersive imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper reading surfaces and midnight exploration surfaces.
Newsreader headings, IBM Plex Sans prose, and IBM Plex Mono data.
Flat editorial layouts with fine rules and varied image proportions.
Visible navigation, source credits, and explicit work-in-progress status.
Responsive reading layouts with keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
dos: Do retain warm paper reading surfaces, midnight exploration surfaces, blueprint blue interaction, and amber pending states.
Do preserve Newsreader hierarchy, Plex Sans reading text, and Plex Mono technical notation.
Do keep source credits, factual captions, dates, and limitations close to the material they describe.
Do retain visible navigation, meaningful labels, keyboard focus, responsive reflow, and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve complete static content and enhance it with small, optional browser interactions.
donts: Don't add raised card shadows or turn metadata tags into rounded promotional pills.
Don't replace conventional navigation with an immersive or blocking entry sequence.
Don't present archive imagery, diagrams, or source-file traces as student hardware photographs or measured results.
Don't hide unfinished calibration, exploratory work, missing documents, or source limitations behind visual polish.
Don't describe this source-derived documentation as a screenshot review, a browser-computed audit, or an approved visual comp.
